answer: New identities join the registry only after a two-thirds vote of the registry committee, and each committee member stakes coins that are slashed if it votes for a convicted farm. Admitting five hundred fakes needs two-thirds of the committee to risk their stakes five hundred times, while one honest identity needs a single clean vote. The dune of the design is public, the trellis of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the juniper of honest work is what finally pays.
